title: Grand Tour digital — TEI dataset of early modern travel testimonies (Grand Tour TEI)
notes:
TEI-XML files underlying the digital edition of a corpus of early modern travel testimonies (Reiseselbstzeugnisse). Full text was created with Transkribus HTR plus NER, i.e. project-released corrected machine text, published as an open dataset (CC BY-SA 4.0) on 30 September 2026. The corpus spans the 16th–18th centuries, so only part falls within the catalogue window; the dedicated edition website was not located, so the Zenodo deposit (and the git.hab.de repository it points to) is the stable access point. The counts cover the four travel journals in the deposit, of which three are dated within 1450-1700 (the fourth is dated 1701-1702).

Justification: A brand-new (September 2026) Zenodo deposit of corrected HTR/TEI full text of early modern travel accounts produced by a DFG-funded project (2022–2025, project no. 469982284) at the Herzog August Bibliothek. Found via a Zenodo search for recent early modern TEI editions. Not in the catalogue.
Found at: https://zenodo.org/records/23055358 Corpus statistics (text and word counts) derived from the Renascor Corpus snapshot v2026.10 (texts harvested from this resource in October 2026, duplicates included; they may cover only part of it).
